entities.name: Lina Wertmüller
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Arcangela Felice Assunta "Lina" Wertmüller  was an Italian film director and screenwriter. She is best known for her 1970s art house films Seven Beauties, The Seduction of Mimi, Love and Anarchy, and Swept Away.
